t: This is Church Row, a quiet residential street in Hampstead, running from Frognal in the west to Heath Street in the east. Many of the houses along it are listed buildings. At the western end you reach St John-at-Hampstead and its additional burial ground. Two people connect to the street. Piers Plowright, the BBC radio producer, was born in Hampstead, and worked at the BBC from 1968 until he retired in 1997. Sir Graham Hearne, a solicitor and finance director, lived here, and chaired Enterprise Oil from 1991 until 2002.
